pages.text: The reactor feeds on liquid fuel: fill a Fuel Cell (10,000 mb / 10 L) with the Fuel Canner and place it in the controller's fuel slots. Fuel drains at a constant rate of 1 mb every 10 seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Utilization & per-slot output (optimal temperature):$()$(li)Sculk Life Fuel: 2, 300k/t$(li)Nether Compound Fuel: 4, 600k/t$(li)End Mixture Fuel: 4, 600k/t$(li)Advanced Mixture Fuel: 5, 750k/t$(li)Pure Fuel: 7, 1.05M/t$(li)Dragon Fuel: 7, 1.05M/t$(li)Ultimate Mixture Fuel: 10, 1.5M/t$(br2)10 fuel rods burning Ultimate Mixture yields roughly 15M/t total.

$(bold)Acquiring fuel:$()$(li)Energy Liquefier: Nether Star → Nether Pure Energy; Wither Rose → Nether Compound Energy; End Mixture → End Mixture Fuel; Sculk Lifeform → Sculk Life Fuel; Dragon Mixture → Dragon Fuel (some recipes need Life Essence Solids)$(li)Energy Processor: refines pure/compound energy into Pure Fuel and Nether Compound Fuel$(li)Fuel Mixer: End Mixture + Nether Compound → Advanced Mixture; Dragon Fuel + Pure → Ultimate Mixture$(br2)All three mixture ingredients (End Mixture, Dragon Mixture, Sculk Lifeform) are crafted at a crafting table.
